text.description_html:
First Impressions CFRBA Copper Acrylic Door Pull

Made in the USA by the master craftsmen at First Impressions from the finest copper acrylic available. The acrylic is manufactured with UV inhibitors to prevent fading.

Specifications for First Impressions CFRBA Copper Acrylic Door Pull

  • Pull Length 48"
  • Pull Handle Diameter: 1.5"
  • Total Projection: 3.25"
  • Pull Handle Material: Copper Acrylic
  • Pull Bracket Material: Solid Brass

Packaged Standard with Thrubolt mounting (Bolts thru the door). Optional Surface mounting or Back to Back mounting available (Pulls bolt to each other - Requires 2 door pulls).

*Sold individually.
